name: Kick The Buddy 3D
summary:
Cool stress relief game! Enjoy the 3D gameplay!
Your good old buddy is here but in a cool 3D revamp! Play with Buddy in his new exciting game, and try out new sets of powerful weapons!

Experiment, blow up, use atomic weapon, dress Buddy up, and do so much more in the brand-new Kick The Buddy 3D!

Enjoy amazing 3D graphics, new levels with Buddy, hilarious weapons, bright backgrounds, and lots of brand-new features.
